name: Sommerrodelbahn Classic
identityNote: Classic is the trough ride beginning at the middle cable-car station. Blomberg Blitz is a separate rail coaster from the valley; their ticket bundles can overlap but the attractions should not be merged.

calendar.nuance: The dedicated official hours page marked Sunday 15 November closed due to moisture and ice. The attraction overview showed a conflicting older 12:30–15:30 window, so the dedicated hours page and daily closure notice take precedence. No later dates are inferred; the dry-track rule applies.

pricing: Operator 2026 table: with uphill lift adult €10/€25.50/€43 for 1/3/6 rides; child age 8–13 €6.50/€17/€29. Downhill only adult €8.50, child 8–13 €6. Tickets for ages 3–7 are also listed in the operator table; under-eight riders sit with an adult. Bundled card use across Classic and Blitz is noted. Prices must be rechecked for 2027.
